name: FinTechCore
description: Financial workflow composition layer. Crypto Module 01 now includes FT-0 through FT-6B contracts for research/paper, durable traceability, deterministic risk/compliance, canonical fixed-point OrderIntent binding and typed reconciliation without productive scoring or real execution authority.

events.note: FT-6B intentionally adds no speculative EventMesh names. Typed append-only reconciliation evidence carries supervisorEscalationRequired until a canonical event catalog defines an unambiguous event name.

implementedAreas: core contracts and immutable module registry
provenance-aware category analysis profiles and feature contracts
detector-agnostic pattern research with non-authorizing evidence
deterministic replayable paper trading with explicit costs
single canonical FinTechCore fixed-point representation reused by paper and OrderIntent contracts
deterministic risk and compliance gates using versioned external policy snapshots
append-only risk/compliance decision evidence with input/output hashes
PAPER-only OrderIntent binding derived from approved FT-5 decision records
exact decision hash and policy identity binding
typed decision-to-intent and paper-fill reconciliation with mismatch escalation evidence
single appendOrderIntent persistence port with versioned v1 legacy and v2 canonical RPC paths
service-role-only FT-6B migration prepared but not applied
DeFiLlama protocol evidence provider remains evidence-only and outside scoring/order authority
blockedAreas: FT-6B production migration application and verification
canonical FT-6 EventMesh event-name publication pending event catalog authority
live acquisition of remaining category-specific evidence
category evidence promotion into canonical scoring without explicit model-contract approval
24-asset crypto universe final availability/evidence admission proof
concrete TA-Lib or other detector runtime binding

authorityBoundary: FinTechCore composes financial workflows and typed evidence but cannot select or calculate productive scores outside ScoringModelRegistry/ScoringDispatcher. CryptoOrchestrator and pattern/agent outputs remain research-only unless separately promoted by existing evidence/model contracts. FT-6B derives OrderIntent approvals only from authoritative append-only FT-5 decisions, uses deterministic fixed point for execution-relevant financial values, remains PAPER-only, asserts no real execution or settlement finality, and cannot replace IAM, Compliance, Quality, Governance, Supervisor, Release or Deployment authorities.
